test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose from the following the novel written by Vikram Seth.

options.text: One Night at the Call Centre

solution:
The correct answer is __**A Suitable Boy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A Suitable Boy is a 1993 novel by Vikram Seth.
 
• These are the longest novels ever published in a single volume in the English language.
 
• Within a new** post-independence post-partition India**, a suitable boy is set up.
 
• Vikram Seth is a writer and poet from India.
 
• He has been awarded several prizes including Pravasi Bharatiya Samman, Padma Shri, Sahitya Academy Award, WH Smith Literary Award, and Crossword Book Award.​
